shipLog.text: ◆ Welcome aboard! At any stop, STOP opens the Stop menu! Mine, scan, rest, repair, trade! Each one takes time and effort! RESUME flies us on!
◆ Planting complete! ARIA has started a growth chart and already drawn the line going up! The line is a prediction! It is a confident one!
Arrived at Nebula 1! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Departure Protocol: we chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Love that for us!
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ We have materials! ARIA has ideas! The FABRICATOR, from the Stop menu, prints hull patches, repair kits and more! Each print wears it a little!
Arrived at The Refueling Opportunity! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
A Word, Captain: we chose “"Full dose. We'll find more."”. Love that for us!
The crew's mood lifts. −1 MEDKIT, +6 MORALE, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ A STATION! With people! ARIA loves stations! Dock for the market and the rooms, and the Stop menu has MEDBAY, DRYDOCK and FAB SERVICE while you're here!
Arrived at Soil Sample Paradise! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Passenger Manifest: One (1)…: we chose “Confine them until the next stop”. Love that for us!
You assign them quarters and a schedule that keeps them out of the… −4 MORALE, 1 DAY. Still a win!
◆ We have stuff in the hold! INV opens it! You can USE things, see which events they open, sell them when docked, or throw them out the airlock! ARIA would never!
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 26% grown, health 100. Thriving!
Arrived at Fort Probably Fine! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ MARV files a note on what looking back at everything from far away does to crews. The effect has a name.
The Middle: we chose “Mark it — small ceremony, real juice”. Love that for us!
The crew assembles at the viewport for the equator crossing. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ A FORK ahead! Two ways to go! The route labels are real, so pick the kind of trouble you like best!
Arrived at Route Decision! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
The Company Memo: we chose “Corporate Approved route”. Love that for us!
You chose the insured route. 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Tip! The readout strip under the gauges opens ORDERS! Pace, rations and the water split! ARIA likes LUDICROUS! ARIA has been told not to choose!

identity.name: Old Marrow
identity.story: They were a seed-bank keeper on a station that decommissioned around them. They heard — through the janitors' network, naturally — that a ship was hauling a live crop to a new world, and could not bear not to be near it. They have been secretly adjusting your growbay's nutrient mix for two weeks. The crop's recent good week was not luck.
identity.line: The zinnias needed magnesium. Everything needs magnesium eventually. So. Am I staying?
identity.join_note: A second green thumb. If a botanist is already aboard, the two of them will disagree about magnesium forever.
